project_identity.name: Dotindot Internal Operations & Growth Platform
project_identity.aesthetic_tone: Clean, spacious, modern internal SaaS. Crisp white surfaces, deep orange gradients, generous whitespace, high visual density where needed, chart-first analytics. Anti-dark generic admin panel.

logo_spec.icon: Bold orange letter 'D' SVG with a pristine white circular dot cutout at the exact center.
logo_spec.wordmark: lowercase 'dotindot.' rendered in Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit bold, text-transparent bg-clip-text with orange gradient fill.
logo_spec.implementation_note: Recreated in pure React SVG/Tailwind component (DotindotLogo.js) to avoid external image asset dependency.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

brand_system.currency_format: INR (₹) formatted as Indian numbering standard (e.g., ₹12,50,000)

sidebar.header: Logo block with 'dotindot.' brand mark and 'Ops v1.0' badge
sidebar.footer: Active logged-in user card with role badge, quick status indicator, and quick logout button

topbar.background: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gray-200 z-30 sticky top-0

components.center: Central search input (data-testid='global-search-input') with auto-complete modal overlay searching clients, projects, users, and tasks
components.right: Role badge chip (Admin / Ops Lead / Developer), quick action '+ New Project' trigger button, notification drawer bell, user avatar menu dropdown

features: Split landing view: Left brand promo container with orange gradient background mesh, right crisp white login form card.
Quick Role Selector Demo Buttons: 'Login as Super Admin', 'Login as Ops Manager', 'Login as Project Lead' for effortless reviewer testing.
Form fields: Email input (data-testid='login-email-input'), Password input (data-testid='login-password-input'), Submit button (data-testid='login-submit-button').
Remember me checkbox & demo credentials tooltip.
Welcome Card: Personal greeting based on active user role (e.g., 'Welcome back, Alex (Super Admin)').
Count Stats Grid (4 key metrics cards): Total Active Clients, Active Projects, Total Pipeline Value (₹), Expiring Contracts (<30d).
Chart-first Grid: Monthly Revenue Trends (Area Chart), Client Distribution by Health (Donut), Project Deliverable Completion (Bar Chart).
Actionable Exception Queue: List of contracts expiring within 30 days and projects needing attention.
Chart Header: Interactive Recharts Donut ('Clients by Status') and Bar Chart ('Clients by Industry').
Filters Toolbar: Search input (data-testid='client-search-input'), Status filter pills (All, Active, Onboarding, At-Risk, Past), Industry select filter.
Clients Table & Grid Switcher: Health status badge ('Healthy' green pulse, 'Watch' yellow pulse, 'At-Risk' red pulse), MRR in INR (₹), project count, action drawer.
Per-Client Detail Tabs:
1. Overview: Key metrics, health score meter, recent project activity timeline.
2. Projects: Active & past projects assigned to this client with progress bars.
3. Contacts: Key client stakeholders (Name, Role, Email, Phone, Primary tag).
4. Contracts: Active agreements list, end date, value in ₹, explicit 30-day expiry warning flag tag.
5. Credentials: Masked credentials vault (Staging URL, DB, API keys) with eye icon toggle (data-testid='reveal-credential-btn') & click-to-copy.
6. Details & Notes: Rich text client notes editor, tags, industry metadata.
Projects List Header: Status summary chart (In Progress, Review, Completed, On Hold) + total budget in ₹ metric.
Multi-Step New Project Wizard (4 Steps + Review Modal):
- Step 1: General Info (Name, Client, Service Category, Priority)
- Step 2: Timeline & Milestones (Start date, Target launch date, Milestones builder)
- Step 3: Team & Deliverables (Assign lead, team members, deliverables checklist generator)
- Step 4: Budget & Financials (Total Budget ₹, Billing terms, Margin estimation)
- Step 5: Review & Submit (Summary overview card + Submit button data-testid='create-project-submit-btn')
Project Detail View:
- Interactive Milestones Timeline (Visual horizontal/vertical node chain with status icons)
- Deliverables Checklist with interactive completion checkboxes (data-testid='deliverable-checkbox')
- Team Members list with avatar images and roles
- Budget Gauge: Total vs Spent (₹) progress tracker with margin indicator
User Management Table: User avatars, names, emails, assigned roles (Admin, Ops Manager, Project Lead, Finance, Client Viewer).
Role Assignment Selector & Quick Add User modal with permissions matrix indicator.
Clean, inspiring 'Coming in Phase 2' canvas with animated SVG graphic, module roadmap summary, and 'Notify Me / Join Beta' interaction.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns, table rows, tabs, search) MUST carry explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='client-tab-credentials', data-testid='global-search-input').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast ratio against white/gray surfaces. High visibility focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F26B21]).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact component guidelines for React .js files.
Ensure the custom SVG logo Dotindot is used in sidebar and auth screens.
All monetary figures MUST be displayed in INR (₹) using Indian numbering format.
Ensure every search input, filter tab, modal button, and tab trigger has explicit data-testid attributes.
Ensure Recharts components are styled with smooth curves and orange (#F26B21) & status accent colors.
